title: Gender Violence against Women
description: Women who have experienced physical and/or psychological violence, threats and sexual violence from a any perpetrator.

title: Domestic Gender Violence against Women
description: Women who have experienced physical and/or psychological violence, threats and sexual violence from a domestic perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence against Women
description: Women who have experienced physical and/or psychological violence, threats and sexual violence from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence against Women
description: Women who have experienced physical and/or psychological violence, threats and sexual violence from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by occurence
description: Women who have experienced violence in adulthood, last 12 months or last 5 years from any perpetrator.

title: Domestic Gender Violence by occurence
description: Women who have experienced violence in adulthood, last 12 months or last 5 years from a domestic perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by occurence
description: Women who have experienced violence in adulthood, last 12 months or last 5 years from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by occurence
description: Women who have experienced violence in adulthood, last 12 months or last 5 years from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by Age
description: Women who have experienced violence by age groups from any perpetrator.

title: Domestic Gender Violence by Age
description: Women who have experienced violence by age groups from a domestic perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by Age
description: Women who have experienced violence by age groups from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by Age
description: Women who have experienced violence by age groups from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by Reporting
description: Women who have experienced violence by any perpetrator and reported to a close person, health or social service, support service, police or any person.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by Reporting
description: Women who have experienced violence by an intimate partner and reported to a close person, health or social service, support service, police or any person.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by Reporting
description: Women who have experienced violence by a non intimate partner and reported to a close person, health or social service, support service, police or any person.

title: Gender Violence by Consequences
description: Women who have experienced Physical injury, Psychological consequences or have Felt that their life was in danger after violence from any perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by Consequences
description: Women who have experienced Physical injury, Psychological consequences or have Felt that their life was in danger after violence from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by Consequences
description: Women who have experienced Physical injury, Psychological consequences or have Felt that their life was in danger after violence from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by Victim limitations
description: Women with None, Some, Severe or limited level of disability (activity limitation) who have experienced violence from any perpetrator.

title: Domestic Gender Violence by Victim limitations
description: Women with None, Some, Severe or limited level of disability (activity limitation) who have experienced violence from a domestic perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by Victim limitations
description: Women with None, Some, Severe or limited level of disability (activity limitation) who have experienced violence from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by Victim limitations
description: Women with None, Some, Severe or limited level of disability (activity limitation) who have experienced violence from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by Victim education
description: Women with less than primary, primary and lower secondary, upper secondary or tertiary education (ISCED levels 0-2, 3-4, 5-8) who have experienced violence from any perpetrator.

title: Domestic Gender Violence by Victim education
description: Women with less than primary, primary and lower secondary, upper secondary or tertiary education (ISCED levels 0-2, 3-4, 5-8) who have experienced violence from a domestic perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by Victim education
description: Women with less than primary, primary and lower secondary, upper secondary or tertiary education (ISCED levels 0-2, 3-4, 5-8) who have experienced violence from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by Victim education
description: Women with less than primary, primary and lower secondary, upper secondary or tertiary education (ISCED levels 0-2, 3-4, 5-8) who have experienced violence from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by Victim residence
description: Women with residence in Cities, Towns or Rural areas who have experienced violence from any perpetrator.

title: Domestic Gender Violence by Victim residence
description: Women with residence in Cities, Towns or Rural areas who have experienced violence from a domestic perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by Victim residence
description: Women with residence in Cities, Towns or Rural areas who have experienced violence from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by Victim residence
description: Women with residence in Cities, Towns or Rural areas who have experienced violence from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by Victim nationality
description: Women from EU, Non-EU or Reporting countries except reporting country who have experienced violence from any perpetrator.

title: Domestic Gender Violence by Victim nationality
description: Women from EU, Non-EU or Reporting countries except reporting country who have experienced violence from a domestic perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by Victim nationality
description: Women from EU, Non-EU or Reporting countries except reporting country who have experienced violence from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by Victim nationality
description: Women from EU, Non-EU or Reporting countries except reporting country who have experienced violence from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by relation
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence by partner - male or female - non partner or family member.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by relation
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence by partner - male or female - non partner or family member.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by relation
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence by partner - male or female - non partner or family member.

title: Repeated Gender Violence
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence At least once a week, less than once a month or at least once a month from any perpetrator.

title: Intimate Repeated Gender Violence
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence At least once a week, less than once a month or at least once a month from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Repeated Gender Violence
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence At least once a week, less than once a month or at least once a month from a non intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by duration
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence for less than 1 year, for from 1 to 5 years and for over 5 years from any perpetrator.

title: Intimate Gender Violence by duration
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence for less than 1 year, for from 1 to 5 years and for over 5 years from an intimate partner.

title: Non Intimate Gender Violence by duration
description: Women who have experienced repeated violence for less than 1 year, for from 1 to 5 years and for over 5 years from a non intimate partner.

title: Intimate Economic Gender Violence by age
description: Women who have experienced economic violence (forbidding the respondent to work, controlling the finances of the whole family) by age groups from an intimate partner.

title: Gender Violence by injury occurence
description: Women who have experienced injuries after violence in adulthood, last 12 months or last 5 years by any perpetrator.
